rule: Undoing only the operations below, in order, must give the exact v1 bytes (tools/static_audit_r1.py). v1 itself is chained to the NORMAL480 originals by its own static audit (81 checks), which the r1 audit runs again.
scope_kept: Java, entry, physics, request list, coordinates, baseline CSV bindings, limits, budgets, paths and identifiers are unchanged (byte-identical Java and entry; CONTRACT differs in one status string).

reverse.reason: mesh_evidence now requires exactly one well-formed DOF line inside the single Time-Dependent Solver section (the same opening / closing markers native_stop already requires once): missing, outside-only (e.g. the Stationary initialization 1202+12), ambiguous (two or more lines) or malformed is TRANSIENT_DOF_READBACK_* -> I-3 incomplete. A valid value different from the extrapolated 156,925+12 is recorded with its difference and a review note, never a failure. The six mesh read-back lines are unchanged.

BMIN-N1: $bNativeAxis initialised, computed once right after GDecision by GNativeAxis, and passed to the three GFields calls (PARENT_LOCAL_DECISION, FINAL_BOUNDARY, POST_WRITE console line). BMIN-N2: GDecision also requires mesh_readback.transient_dof with an integer solved > 0.

GNativeAxis: the parent verifies the native child return (returned, rc 0, no exception / new error), run / manifest binding of the result, and the termination evidence (the same structural checks GDecision applies: reported / final / safe-prefix times, stored-time count, guards, stop reason, normal 150 s or a coherent protective stop) and then requires the consumer label to agree; any failure gives NOT_ESTABLISHED with a cause (NATIVE_CHILD_RETURN_MISSING_OR_ERROR, NATIVE_CHILD_RC, TERMINATION_EVIDENCE_MISSING, RESULT_IDENTITY, TERMINATION_EVIDENCE_INVALID, CONSUMER_NATIVE_LABEL_MISMATCH). GFields takes native_completion from that axis whatever the comparison / evidence / analysis / delivery outcome; only a parent-accepted normal result (AWAITING label and a NORMAL axis) carries the consumer comparison verdict, everything else is evidence_validity INVALID and mesh_comparison INCONCLUSIVE. GNativeAxis repeats GDecision's three nested helpers byte for byte (PowerShell nested functions are not visible outside their parent).

CODE_MANIFEST.json.changed: previous_manifest_sha256 = v1 manifest; sizes / SHA-256 of the three changed files

COMMAND_MAP.json.changed: manifest SHA only (manifest_sha256 and the last argv of parent / execute / analyze)

known_limits: The entry (unchanged) returns rc 1 when its preservation / policy / cleanup checks fail after a native run; the parent cannot tell those apart from a native failure, so such a run stays native_completion NOT_ESTABLISHED (cause NATIVE_CHILD_RC) - conservative; the stage of each error is in NATIVE_STATE.json.
GNativeAxis checks the consumer's structured termination output (as GDecision does), not the raw native logs; the consumer reads the logs.
c1_wording: PS01-03 / PS01-04 check the limit-adjacent values and label consistency only; they are not decimal-precision rounding tests. r1 adds PS01-16 (a 31-significant-digit maximum just above the limit) whose expected result is INCOMPLETE through the consumer / parent disagreement - the fail-closed principle, not a precision guarantee.
